test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Integrate
solution:
The correct answer is: **Separate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Integrate: **To combine or bring together different parts into a whole. (एकीकृत करना)

 
 
• Example: The new policy aims to integrate immigrant children into the public education system.
 
 
 
• **Separate: **To set or keep apart. (अलग करना)
 
 
• Example: The teacher decided to separate the two students who were constantly talking during class.
 
 
 
• We can see that the antonym of 'integrate' is 'separate'

Therefore, the correct answer is **Separate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Influence: **The power to have an effect on people or things. (प्रभाव)

 
 
• Example: The politician's speech had a significant influence on the voters.
 
 
 
• **Accept: **To consent to receive or undertake. (स्वीकार करना)
 
 
• Example: She decided to accept the job offer.
 
 
 
• **Excite: **To cause strong feelings of enthusiasm and eagerness. (उत्तेजित करना) 
 
 
• Example: The announcement of the concert excited all the fans.
